category.name: VPN and private network access
category.description: Identity-aware private connectivity for remote staff, devices and internal resources.
category.audience: IT and security teams serving remote staff
category.audienceRationale: Many employees benefit from private access, while product selection and operation primarily belong to network, IT and security teams; narrower buying audience than general business collaboration.

pricing.note: Standard $8/seat/month. Resource and platform add-ons extra; Personal free plan is non-commercial. Monthly seat billing documented.
Pay-as-you-go $7/user/month paid annually. Product page also offers a free plan for teams under 50 users; paid product remains distinct from open-source connector software.

oss.name: NetBird Community Edition
locked: Enterprise Commercial License: active-active HA, SCIM provisioning, EDR/MDM integration, traffic-flow logging/streaming, peer approval, audit-event streaming and notifications.
serviceLimitations: Self-hosters operate control plane and relays; hosting and relay bandwidth have infrastructure costs.
oss.classificationReason: OSI community code: root BSD-3-Clause excludes management, signal, relay and combined directories licensed AGPLv3. Core connectivity/access control/routing remain community features; documented enterprise administration, approval and observability gates warrant B. NetBird Cloud tiers are separate from self-hosted Enterprise licensing.

health.rsx: Authenticated shared analysis succeeded; overall 6.2/10. Not a security certification.

oss.name: Headscale
serviceLimitations: Narrow single-tailnet Tailscale-compatible control-server scope; personal/lab/small-organisation focus.
Requires separately distributed compatible Tailscale clients; community web interfaces are separate projects.
No first-party hosted service identified in official project documentation.
oss.classificationReason: BSD-3-Clause self-hosted control server with no commercial edition or paid software gate found in official project docs. A applies to this narrow server, not enterprise Tailscale platform parity. No built-in web interface; clients are separate.

health.rsx: Authenticated shared analysis succeeded; overall 7.3/10. Not a security certification.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Re-enrol devices with NetBird clients and recreate identities, DNS, routing and access policies. Community includes networking but enterprise provisioning, approvals and flow observability require the commercial self-hosted license; Tailscale platform extensions are not interchangeable.

Use compatible Tailscale clients configured for a new Headscale control-server URL; re-register nodes and recreate policy, DNS and routes. One tailnet, small-organisation focus; no built-in web UI or promised enterprise-service parity.

Scope is remote private-network access through NetBird clients and access policies. Rebuild enrolment and resource rules and operate infrastructure. Cloudflare clientless application access, browser terminals and broader SASE services need separate evaluation; no full platform replacement claim.

uncertainties: Headscale client and feature compatibility changes across releases; check supported client versions before migration.
No business deployment or migration was executed; capability mappings derive from current official documentation.
